top_choice_rationale: P002 (Katori and Ye, optical lattice clocks) is the most complete, independently reproduced and cleanly citable achievement: the magic-wavelength lattice removes Doppler and recoil shifts for a neutral-atom ensemble, and 10^-18 systematic uncertainty has been confirmed across laboratories, with the atomic-structure physics checked by colleagues who can judge it. P001 (magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene) opens a new regime and is the larger discovery, but the pairing mechanism is unsettled and the three-name credit leaves out Cao, Fatemi and others, so I rank it second and well above no award; I would accept it with Bistritzer retained.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no recorded tie to Katori, Ye, MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero or Bistritzer (B009 astroparticle proximity is not in any proposal on the slate)
